digest.component_or_area: CLI close precheck / code root resolution
propositions: CLI close precheck incorrectly derives code repository root as the parent directory of an out-of-worktree REBAR_TRACKER_DIR, causing git log scans to search the wrong worktree for commit trailers.

When REBAR_TRACKER_DIR is relocated outside the code repository, rebar transition closed --ref HEAD falsely reports no matching commit trailer despite the trailer existing in the current code worktree HEAD.
The defect affects both commit evidence verification and completion-gate configuration because both conflate the tracker parent directory with the code repository root.

The fix must resolve code_root through config.repo_root (explicit/REBAR_ROOT/cwd git toplevel) independently from ticket state resolution via config.tracker_dir to support documented custom tracker configurations.
Default in-repo tracker behavior and true-missing-commit failures must remain unchanged by the fix.
